name: Trödel- und Antikmarkt am Aachener Platz
facts: since 1976, moved to Aachener Platz in 1980; organiser calls it Germany's first weekly flea market
heated tent hall plus open-air grounds, café and beer garden
antiques, second-hand, some new goods (B-stock) in a separate area
live jazz in the café on Saturdays, 11:30–14:30
free shuttle bus 893 from the Südpark/Südfriedhof car parks; U71/U72/U73/U79, S1/S8/S11 via Bilk
organiser reports up to 20,000 visitors on a good day (2011 figure)
notes: Homepage says 'ab 8:00', Anreise/Marktordnung say 08:30–17:00 — used the latter. No holiday or winter-break info anywhere on the site, so 26 Dec 2026 and 2 Jan 2027 are included but unconfirmed. Venue address is the same as the organiser's office (Ulenbergstraße 10).

description.de: Seit 1976 jeden Samstag, seit 1980 am Aachener Platz: ein beheiztes Zelt, ein Freigelände, ein Café mit Biergarten und samstags Live-Jazz zwischen 11.30 und 14.30 Uhr. Antiquitäten und Gebrauchtes, Neuware nur in einem eigenen Bereich. Eintritt frei; Gratis-Shuttle 893 von den Parkplätzen am Südpark, Bahnen über Bilk.
description.en: Every Saturday since 1976, on Aachener Platz since 1980: a heated tent hall, open-air grounds, a café with a beer garden and live jazz on Saturdays from 11.30 to 2.30. Antiques and second-hand, with new stock kept to a separate area. Entry is free; a free shuttle bus 893 runs from the Südpark car parks, trains via Bilk.
